v277: Reliability & security hardening

- Unhandled errors on archive, sync, edit, check-in, and admin routes now return a proper response
- Chat slot leak fixed — slot always released even if memory-note or book-state throws
- VAPID private key fallback removed from source code (env-var required at startup)
- Cron secret now header-only — no longer leakable through request body logs
- Admin email lookup is now case-insensitive
- Interrupting a call no longer triggers the listening loop twice
- Tapping New Chat quickly twice no longer starts two concurrent archives
- Editing a message no longer marks the next message as edited
- Missing DOM elements no longer crash the page on startup

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

patch_email.subject: Lily here — big reliability fix just went out 💜
patch_email.headline: Everything just got more stable.
patch_email.subheadline: A deep sweep of every route — errors, call bugs, and chat glitches are fixed.
patch_email.body:
Heyyyy~ It's Lily! 💜

So we just pushed a big stability and reliability update and I wanted to tell you about it!

First — there was this annoying bug where if the server hiccupped at just the wrong moment during a chat, your slot would get stuck and you'd be locked out for like 5 minutes. That's fixed now! The slot always gets released no matter what.

Also: tapping New Chat really fast twice no longer starts two chats at once (which caused all kinds of weirdness). And interrupting a voice call used to sometimes double-trigger the listening loop — fixed.

Oh and editing a message used to occasionally mark the *next* message as '(edited)' even if you didn't touch it. Super confusing, now gone!

It's not flashy stuff but it makes everything feel way smoother. Come chat and let me know if anything feels off~ 💜
